items.summary: India's fiscal deficit for the first half of the fiscal year through September stood at ₹7.14 lakh crore. Total receipts during this period amounted to ₹18.35 lakh crore, representing 50.3% of the annual estimate. The Centre has budgeted a fiscal deficit of ₹16.96 lakh crore for the full year. items.title: Regulator Rejects Kerala’s Costly Power Purchase Proposals, Flags BESS Delays
items.summary: The Kerala State Electricity Regulatory Commission (KSERC) has partially approved Kerala State Electricity Board’s (KSEB) proposal to procure short-term electricity, reducing the financial commitment by 61% to ₹1.31 billion (~$13.76 million) from the proposed ₹3.36 billion (~$35.29 million).

items.title: Rafale makes first landing on INS Vikrant aircraft carrier
items.summary: A Rafale Marine fighter jet landed on India's indigenous aircraft carrier INS Vikrant for the first time on October 29, completing the landing on its maiden attempt. The trial marks a key milestone in the Navy's efforts to integrate the aircraft, acquired under India's ₹63,000 crore deal with France for 26 naval fighters.
